dbd16d283708d246cf3aefbb1eadc05431cf0c90.finding: FantasyRankingBook420._close(bytes32) (contracts/src/bet/fantasy/FantasyRankingBook420.sol#127-137) performs a multiplication on the result of a division:
dbd16d283708d246cf3aefbb1eadc05431cf0c90.rationale: Intentional full-precision quotient/remainder decomposition, not premature truncation. Development fee recombines quotient*3 and remainder*3/100. Tie entitlement recombines prize/denominator*weight and its remainder product; denominator is uint64 group size * 10000 and weight<=10000, bounding the intermediate product.

Ranking/policy/admission modules are constructor-created and not replaceable; oracle/profile reads are static calls. Controller cancellation/review/publication is fixed code, and current-candidate callbacks are read-only. No callback can mutate engine credit or settle a stale/unresolved candidate.

signatureVariantReview: Linux Slither 0.11.6 additionally reports p.netPrize = p.gross - p.fee in _startReview after _lockPool. Reviewed against unchanged source: every public mutator is nonReentrant, the host-created immutable dispute module cannot mutate this host through its read callbacks, and _lockPool cancellation cannot proceed past the LOCKED state guard. Windows omits this propagated alias write. Both exact raw reports retained; no severity or source assertion relaxed.
